bio: Hi — I'm Tom, a CTO and hands-on technology executive who builds products, teams, and systems at scale. Over the last year I've gone deep on agentic AI—using GitHub Copilot agent mode and Claude to ship full-stack products from scratch: a live AI home & car inventory platform (homecardiy.com), an interactive Japan trip companion app, and more in the works. I also take photos, love sports, and believe the best engineering leaders never stop coding.
name: Tom Lacy
title: Executive Engineering Leader
